_comment: #1315 item 2 (atonia notes §2.1): Tool classes that reach a process sink but declare less than Effect.ALL, because the argv is fixed and hardened. Online only: under offline the audit-hook latch refuses every spawn (V8), so these drop. Git's config-driven filters can still run code despite GIT_HARDENING_ARGS; that residual is stated in the notes.

exemptions.reason: fixed argv `git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --end-of-options` plus tools/base.py::GIT_HARDENING_ARGS and git_env(); read-only
fixed argv `git add` / `git commit --no-gpg-sign` plus tools/base.py::GIT_HARDENING_ARGS and git_env(); writes the repo inside allowed_dirs (WRITE_LOCAL)
